definition: Fake nude photography is the creation of nude photographs designed to appear as genuine nudes of an individual.
details: The motivations for the creation of these modified photographs include curiosity, sexual gratification, the stigmatization or embarrassment of the subject, and commercial gain, such as through the sale of the photographs via pornographic websites. Fakes can be created using image editing software or through generative artificial intelligence. Fake images created using the latter method are called deepfakes, including deepfake pornography.
